cases.name: code_review
cases.user:
USER: review the webhook signature code
ASSISTANT: Three findings in webhook.rs. First, verify_signature uses == for comparing HMAC digests, which is timing-attack vulnerable; use a constant-time compare. Second, the timestamp check accepts any age, so replayed requests succeed forever — reject anything older than 300 seconds. Third, when the X-Hub-Signature-256 header is absent the function returns Ok(()) instead of an error, so unsigned requests pass. The third is the critical one.
USER: fix all three and add tests
ASSISTANT: Done in commit e485795. Added three tests covering each case, all passing.
